AmbessaPassive.name: Drakehound's Step
AmbessaPassive.tooltip:
When Ambessa is casting an Ability, issuing a Move or Attack order will cause her to dash in that direction after the Ability finishes.

Each cast initiation grants her a charge for @Attack_Buff_Duration@ seconds (max: @Attack_Buff_Max_Stacks@). While Ambessa has a charge, she gains @Attack_Range_Amount@ %i:scaleRange% Attack Range and @Calc_Attack_Speed@ %i:scaleAS% Attack Speed. Attacks consume a charge to deal @Calc_OnHit_Damage_Flat@ physical damage and restore @Calc_OnHit_Energy_Refund@ Energy.

AmbessaQ.name: Cunning Sweep / Sundering Slam
AmbessaQ.tooltip:
Cunning Sweep: Ambessa sweeps her blades forward, dealing @Calc_Damage_1_Max@ + @Calc_Damage_1_Percent_Max@ max Health physical damage to enemies at the edge of the strike. All other enemies take @Calc_Damage_1_Min_Ratio@ damage. Striking an enemy readies a Sundering Slam.

Sundering Slam: Ambessa slams her blades down, dealing @Calc_Damage_2_Max@ + @Calc_Damage_2_Percent_Max@ max Health physical damage against the first enemy hit. All other enemies take @Calc_Damage_2_Min_Ratio@ damage.
Deals an additional @Calc_Damage_Monster_Flat_Bonus@ physical damage to monsters.
The percent of max Health damage to monsters is capped at @Calc_Damage_Monster_Percent_Cap@.

AmbessaR.name: Public Execution
AmbessaR.tooltip:
Passive: Ambessa gains @Armor_Penetration*100@% %i:scaleAPen% Armor Penetration and her Abilities heal her for @Calc_Omnivamp@ of the damage she dealt.

Active: Ambessa becomes Unstoppable and blinks to the farthest enemy champion in a line, Suppressing the target for @Suppress_Duration@ seconds and then slamming them into the ground, dealing @Calc_Damage@ physical damage and Stunning them for @Stun_Duration@ seconds.
Healing is @Omnivamp_MinionMod*100@% effective against minions and @Omnivamp_MonsterMod*100@% effective against monsters.
